newsitem.title: USA: i2 Tech close to contract with auto company.
newsitem.headline: i2 Tech close to contract with auto company.

text.p: i2 Technologies Inc is close to winning a contract for its supply chain management software with a large auto company, Chief Executive Officer Sanjiv Sidhu said.
"We'll have a major announcement in the next two weeks of a very large automotive customer that we are very close to signing on," Sidhu told Reuters in an interview.
"They have told us verbally the purchase orders have been issued, although we haven't received them yet," he said.
Sidhu gave no further details but said the contract, while not huge, will give i2 Technologies its first entry into the lucrative auto industry market.
"The key business in the automotive industry doesn't come from the automakers, it comes from the first-tier suppliers," he said, adding that i2 planned to focus on that segment of the market.
He said the contract would give i2 a "starter" in the market and "a better ability to educate and influence" first-tier manufacturers and suppliers.
